# Git Pulse Copilot Instructions

The canonical instructions are in `AGENTS.md`.

Before modifying code, read:

- `AGENTS.md`
- `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`
- `docs/PRD.md`
- `docs/SRS.md`
- `docs/DATA_CONTRACT.md`
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
- `docs/ROADMAP.md`
- `docs/DECISIONS.md`

Do not violate V1 scope.

Do not silently change:

- contracts
- architecture
- retention
- event semantics

After meaningful implementation work, update:

- `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`
- `docs/CHANGELOG.md`
